summary: T3 Defense Inc. (Nasdaq: DFNS) furnished an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 10, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that its wholly owned subsidiary, Rimon Agencies Ltd., received a purchase order valued at approximately $1.3 million from a leading Israeli defense prime contractor. Rimon will supply engineered power-generation systems for a European production line supporting a critical air-defense system, built to the prime's specifications with deliveries scheduled to the customer's European production facility. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, premium, ownership change, or regulatory clock is involved. This is an ordinary commercial order, not a special situation; watch for follow-on European air-defense orders as a revenue-run-rate signal.
